from: hand-edited: this file is the source of this type's sections, their fields, rules and rendering. J2 builds each section's model and checks from it at load time (j2_artifact_models, j2_rules); python3 j2_template_lib.py checks every generic.json

templates.name: Agent LLD/1 · Tools
templates.description: The generic Agent LLD/1 · Tools template: the fixed layout of every Agent LLD Tools section, whatever the agent

fields.name: tools
fields.description: the contract of every tool the agent calls, T1, T2, ...; "Not needed for this agent: <why>" as an assumption when it calls none

fields.name: id
fields.description: T1, T2, ... in order

fields.name: name
fields.description: the tool's name in code, e.g. "slack_post_digest"

fields.name: component
fields.description: the agent HLD component id it implements, e.g. "C5"

fields.name: purpose
fields.description: what it does and when the agent uses it

fields.name: input
fields.description: what it takes, in one line; each parameter is in Tool inputs

fields.name: returns
fields.description: what it gives back

fields.name: effect
fields.description: read or write

fields.name: on_error
fields.description: what the caller gets back when it fails

fields.name: idempotent
fields.description: true when calling it twice with the same input has the effect of calling it once

fields.name: timeout_seconds
fields.description: the most one call may take

rules.name: ids T1, T2, ... unique and in order

rules.fail_text: {id} names {bad}, which is not a component of the agent HLD
rules.missing_text: {id}: the agent HLD's ids are not recorded, so Names can't be checked
rules.name: component points at a component id of the agent HLD

render.line: - **{id}** `{name}` (on {component}, {effect}): {purpose:nodot}.[ Takes {input:nodot}.] Returns {returns:nodot}. On error: {on_error:nodot}.[ Idempotent: {idempotent:yesno}.][ Times out after {timeout_seconds} s.]

templates.name: Agent LLD/1 · Tool inputs
templates.description: The generic Agent LLD/1 · Tool inputs template: the fixed layout of every Agent LLD Tool inputs section, whatever the agent

fields.name: tool_inputs
fields.description: each parameter of each tool, I1, I2, ...

fields.name: id
fields.description: I1, I2, ... in order

fields.name: tool
fields.description: the tool id, e.g. "T1"

fields.name: name
fields.description: the parameter name

fields.name: type
fields.description: string, integer, number, boolean, array or object

fields.name: required
fields.description: true when the tool can't run without it

fields.name: meaning
fields.description: what it means and its allowed values

rules.name: ids I1, I2, ... unique and in order
type is a JSON Schema type
tool points at a tool id of this document

templates.name: Agent LLD/1 · Prompts
templates.description: The generic Agent LLD/1 · Prompts template: the fixed layout of every Agent LLD Prompts section, whatever the agent

fields.name: prompts
fields.description: each model call, P1, P2, ...; "Not needed for this agent: <why>" as an assumption when the agent calls no model

fields.name: id
fields.description: P1, P2, ... in order

fields.name: file
fields.description: the file that holds the prompt, e.g. "prompts/rank.md"

fields.name: component
fields.description: the agent HLD component id it serves (a model_call or an agent), e.g. "C3"

fields.name: model
fields.description: the model it is sent to, or "the user's configured model"

fields.name: output
fields.description: the fields of the reply, e.g. "{id, score 1-5, reason}"

fields.name: variables
fields.description: what code fills into it

rules.name: ids P1, P2, ... unique and in order

rules.fail_text: {id} names {bad}, which is not a component of the agent HLD
rules.missing_text: {id}: the agent HLD's ids are not recorded, so Names can't be checked
rules.name: component points at a component id of the agent HLD

templates.name: Agent LLD/1 · Limits
templates.description: The generic Agent LLD/1 · Limits template: the fixed layout of every Agent LLD Limits section, whatever the agent

fields.name: limits
fields.description: the numbers that stop a unit of work

fields.name: max_steps
fields.description: the most model calls or loop turns in one unit

fields.name: run_timeout_seconds
fields.description: the most one unit may take

fields.name: max_retries
fields.description: the most retries of one failed call

fields.name: on_limit
fields.description: what happens when a limit is reached

fields.name: cost_cap_per_run
fields.description: the most one unit may cost

rules.name: what happens at a limit is given

render.text:
- At most {limits.max_steps} steps
- At most {limits.run_timeout_seconds} s per unit
- At most {limits.max_retries} retries per call[
- At most {limits.cost_cap_per_run} per unit]
- At a limit: {limits.on_limit}

templates.name: Agent LLD/1 · File structure
templates.description: The generic Agent LLD/1 · File structure template: the fixed layout of every Agent LLD File structure section, whatever the agent

fields.name: files
fields.description: every file of the build

fields.name: path
fields.description: the file path inside the agent's folder, e.g. "digest.py"

fields.name: purpose
fields.description: what it holds

fields.name: states
fields.description: the agent PRD must-never-do ids this file states or enforces, e.g. ["N1"]

fields.name: runs_tests
fields.description: true on exactly one file: the one that, run with the test runner (python3 <path>), runs every test of the Tests section and exits 0 only when all pass

rules.name: every file has a path and a purpose

rules.fail_text: {id} states {bad}, which is not a must-never-do rule of the agent PRD
rules.missing_text: {id}: the agent PRD's ids are not recorded, so States can't be checked
rules.name: states points at a must-never-do id of the agent PRD

templates.name: Agent LLD/1 · Tests
templates.description: The generic Agent LLD/1 · Tests template: the fixed layout of every Agent LLD Tests section, whatever the agent

fields.name: tests
fields.description: the cases the folder's test runs, X1, X2, ... in order

fields.name: id
fields.description: X1, X2, ... in order

fields.name: kind
fields.description: tool (one tool alone), run (a whole unit of work) or never (a must-never-do rule)

fields.name: covers
fields.description: the agent PRD requirement ids it proves, e.g. ["R3"]

fields.name: never
fields.description: the agent PRD must-never-do ids it proves, e.g. ["N1"]

fields.name: setup
fields.description: the faked systems and the scripted model reply it runs with

fields.name: expected
fields.description: the final state it asserts

fields.name: grader
fields.description: code or rubric

fields.name: trials
fields.description: how many times it is run

rules.name: ids X1, X2, ... unique and in order
kind is tool, run or never
every test names a requirement or a must-never-do rule
every test states what it runs with and what it asserts

rules.fail_text: {id} tests {bad}, which is not a must-never-do rule of the agent PRD
rules.missing_text: {id}: the agent PRD's ids are not recorded, so Tests can't be checked
rules.name: never points at a must-never-do id of the agent PRD

rules.fail_text: {id} covers {bad}, which is not a requirement of the agent PRD
rules.missing_text: {id}: the agent PRD's ids are not recorded, so Covers can't be checked
rules.name: covers points at a requirement id of the agent PRD

render.line: - **{id}** ({kind}): with {setup:nodot}, expects {expected:nodot}.[ Covers {covers}.][ Proves {never}.][ Graded by {grader}.][ {trials} trials.]

templates.name: Agent LLD/1 · Config and secrets
templates.description: The generic Agent LLD/1 · Config and secrets template: the fixed layout of every Agent LLD Config and secrets section, whatever the agent

fields.name: config
fields.description: each setting and credential by name, never its value; "Not needed for this agent: <why>" as an assumption when there is none

fields.name: name
fields.description: the setting's name, e.g. "SLACK_CHANNEL"

fields.name: purpose
fields.description: what it sets

fields.name: secret
fields.description: true for a credential, which is never written into a file of the folder

fields.name: default
fields.description: its default, when it has one and is not a secret

templates.name: Agent LLD/1 · Document
templates.description: The generic Agent LLD/1 document template: the whole Agent LLD as one object, every section in order, as the agent reads it and as the renderer writes it
